query_normalized: quantifying hallucination in llm-generated api documentation computer science
rationale: This paper satisfies acceptance criteria (a) and (b) because it directly measures the same core mechanism (LLM hallucination) and evaluates specific quantification methods (fact-based counting and detection metrics) on a domain-specific text generation task, providing essential methodological context for quantifying hallucinations in specialized documentation despite the difference in subject matter (medical vs. API).
